bounds.domain: Two organizations, two retained Session/PaymentIntent identities, one current user membership, immutable grant/quarantine records and a paid custom-amount value of two. Arbitrarily many replay, invalid input, ownership change and cache outcome transitions over that finite domain.
bounds.assumptions: The receipt comes from a verified provider source. valid abstracts paid status, USD, whole positive cents, allowed purchase type, claimed-credit agreement and current customer equality. Membership is read under primary organization/user locks; the model excludes its mutation while that transaction is locked.
bounds.limitations: Finite identity and amount domain. Does not prove provider authenticity, arbitrary-value validation, cross-protocol reversal/deletion composition or unbounded identity cardinality. Receipt-specific comparison tests and SQL locking checks are independent implementation evidence; this is not a TypeScript refinement theorem.
